reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. All approved ambient section instances are part of the contract. Let v,F:E->R and K a subset of E. Assume K is compact, tsupport(v) is contained in K and tsupport(F) is contained in K. Assume both v and F satisfy actual MemLp at exponent 2 with respect to volume, including volume-a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm.
Assume that for every real C2 compactly supported phi:E->R, both functions x->v(x)*Delta(phi)(x) and x->F(x)*phi(x) are volume-integrable and
  integral v(x)*Delta(phi)(x) dx = integral F(x)*phi(x) dx.
Here Delta(phi) is the actual test-function finite-basis Laplacian. No classical derivatives of v or F are assumed.
Then there exist vc,Fc in Lp C 2 volume such that vc=(x->(v(x):C)) volume-almost everywhere and Fc=(x->(F(x):C)) volume-almost everywhere. For these same vc,Fc all of the following conclusions hold simultaneously:
(1) For every psi in SchwartzMap E C, both x->Delta(psi)(x)*(v(x):C) and x->psi(x)*(F(x):C) are volume-integrable and
  integral Delta(psi)(x)*(v(x):C) dx = integral psi(x)*(F(x):C) dx.
(2) Delta(Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc)) = Lp.toTemperedDistribution(Fc).
(3) MemSobolev 2 2 (Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc)).
The classes are selected before all Schwartz tests and the complex test integrals use the original pointwise v and F casts, not newly selected functions per test. The real weak PDE and its two L1 products are premises; the two complex Schwartz L1 products, the complex test equation, the genuine distribution equation and Sobolev membership are conclusions.
Lp C 2 volume is the genuine complex L2 quotient with its standard measurable representative. These volume-a.e. identities bind the chosen classes to the actual pointwise real functions cast into C; they do not assert pointwise support identities for the chosen complex representatives. Every Schwartz test is a genuine smooth rapidly decreasing complex function on the real space E, and no compact-support restriction is imposed on it. Its derivatives are real Frechet derivatives. Pairings and displayed integrals use ordinary complex multiplication with no complex conjugation. Lp.toTemperedDistribution is the genuine complex-linear distribution embedding whose value at psi is integral psi(x)*the L2 representative(x) dx. The distribution Laplacian is the true tempered-distribution operator. MemSobolev 2 2 means there exists an actual fprime in Lp C 2 volume with besselPotential E C 2 of the displayed distribution equal to Lp.toTemperedDistribution(fprime); its multiplier is (1+||xi||^2)^(2/2). The approved Fourier convention is Delta T=-(2*pi)^2 FM(||xi||^2)T. This order-2 Bessel-Sobolev assertion is not a pointwise classical Laplacian, a real Hessian representative, or a weighted-core conclusion.
objects: Actual real functions v,F, compact set K, actual test Laplacian on C2 compact real functions; two genuine complex L2(volume) classes vc,Fc, all complex Schwartz tests and their actual real-variable Laplacians, complex tempered distributions LpTD(vc),LpTD(Fc), genuine distribution Laplacian and the exact Bessel-potential Sobolev membership predicate.
domains: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel E with canonical volume, including dimension zero and all approved ambient instances. v,F:E->R; K:Set E. Real input functions have actual volume-a.e. strong measurability/finite L2 norm. vc,Fc:Lp C 2 volume with standard selected representatives, bound to ofReal(v),ofReal(F) by volume-AE identities. All integrability and integrals are volume; real input tests are C2 compact support, complex output tests are all SchwartzMap E C without compact support restriction. Complex products/pairings are bilinear without conjugation.
quantifiers: Universally over approved ambient E and all real v,F and sets K satisfying each input premise. Real weak premise forall phi:E->R, C2 phi -> compact-support phi -> both integrable products and PDE equality. Exists a single pair vc,Fc before forall psi:SchwartzMap E C and before the simultaneous distribution/Sobolev conclusions. MemSobolev 2 2 itself means existence of one actual complex L2(volume) Bessel-potential witness. No test-dependent selection of vc,Fc.
assumptions: K compact; tsupport v subset K; tsupport F subset K; MemLp v 2 volume; MemLp F 2 volume. For every real C2 compact-support phi both v*Delta(phi) and F*phi volume-integrable with integral v*Delta(phi)=integral F*phi. These real weak PDE/L1 claims are assumptions, not conclusions. No pointwise classical derivatives of v/F, positivity, or nonzero-dimension premise.
conclusion: Exists vc,Fc actual complex L2 classes with volume-AE ofReal identities to v,F, for which every complex Schwartz psi has both actual L1 products Delta(psi)*ofReal(v) and psi*ofReal(F) and their equal integrals; true distribution equality Delta(LpTD(vc))=LpTD(Fc); and MemSobolev 2 2 LpTD(vc), i.e. actual L2(volume) witness representing besselPotential E C 2 LpTD(vc). All conjuncts retained together.
scopes: Real weak tests are only C2 compact support in the premise; output tests are ALL complex Schwartz functions. Their integrals use the original pointwise real inputs cast to C, not a representative replaced separately per test. vc,Fc are volume-a.e. tied to those inputs, without exact pointwise support claims for chosen quotient representatives. LpTD and Fourier multiplier are complex-linear; pairing uses integral psi*vc, no conjugation. No real Hessian/H2 representative, classical Delta v, weighted-core conclusion, solution algorithm, or norm estimate is asserted.
constant_dependencies: L2 exponent exactly 2; Sobolev order and exponent exactly MemSobolev 2 2. Bessel multiplier (1+||xi||^2)^(2/2); approved Fourier normalization Delta T=-(2*pi)^2 FM(||xi||^2)T. Displayed weak equations have unit coefficients and positive sign on RHS. K bounds both actual topological supports; no unspecified numerical estimate constant or size restriction on K. vc,Fc may depend on input v,F,K/premises, not Schwartz tests.
